justifications.r1: Standard Grixis mana rocks and treasure generation.
justifications.r2: Dethrone + aristocrat death draw (Grim Haruspex, Midnight Reaper, River Kelpie) draws cards on every turn.
justifications.a1: High redundancy of sacrifice outlets, counter placers, and ETB burn creatures.
justifications.a2: Assembles Marchesa recursive engine on Turns 5–6.
justifications.p1: Presents persistent board control and drain clock on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: 2 opponent untap steps of end-step recursion and combat drain.
justifications.p3: Aristocrat engine relies on graveyard returns at end of turn.
justifications.i1: Instant removal and sacrifice edicts (Fleshbag Marauder, Plaguecrafter on loop).
justifications.i2: Continuous recurring edicts strip opponents of creatures during every turn cycle.
justifications.s1: Marchesa automatically returns any creature with a +1/+1 counter to the battlefield at end step.
justifications.s2: Wipe-proof engine: creatures dying to wrath return immediately on end step.
justifications.s3: Heavily reliant on Marchesa being on the battlefield to enable the recursion loop.
